name: fpr_classic_balloon_compat
display_name: Classic balloon still tracks memory size changes with FPR off
description: Non-regression contract: with the feature off, QEMU balloon (setmem equivalent) shrinks and grows the guest exactly as before. Directional assertions (deltas > 1.5 GB) instead of absolute values - the reclaimed amount depends on guest state.

test_steps.desc: Make sure FPR is off (classic balloon only)
test_steps.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr removed'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device without the feature
Shrink the guest to 6 GiB via QMP balloon
Grow the guest back to 8 GiB via QMP balloon
Probe available memory after growing back
Verify the classic balloon tracked both directions
test_steps.guest_run: if ((@avail_before@ - @avail_mid@) -gt 1536 -and (@avail_after@ - @avail_mid@) -gt 1536) { Write-Output 'PASS: classic balloon tracks setmem (before @avail_before@ MB, mid @avail_mid@ MB, after @avail_after@ MB)' } else { throw "classic balloon did not track: before @avail_before@ MB, mid @avail_mid@ MB, after @avail_after@ MB" }
